verdict.rationale: The docs describe API regions, rate limits, cost tracking, and Zero Data Retention (ZDR) for privacy, but there is no mention of a distinct sandbox/staging environment or test-mode credentials that let a developer safely exercise tools/agentic workflows separate from production data — ZDR only prevents persistence, it does not create an isolated sandbox. Missing for 10: any documented sandbox/staging API tier, test API keys, or explicit separation of test vs production environments.
